# polaris_principal (Data Source)

Reads metadata of an existing Apache Polaris principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_principal" "analyst" {
  name = "john_engineer"
}

output "principal_client_id" {
  value = data.polaris_principal.analyst.client_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the principal to query.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID associated with the principal.
- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this principal.
